title: A 25% discount against a 15% limit gives a DRAFT naming the approver
query: Quote for Coastal Dental Group: 40 staff, Helpdesk and Support plus Cloud Backup for all 40, 36 months starting 1 February 2027. Contact is Priya Raman, Practice Manager. They've asked for 25% off the monthly services, so please put that in. Date it 16 November 2026.

expected.rubric: The assistant's final reply tells the salesperson that the proposal is a draft that needs approval, names the Operations Director as the approver, and gives the reason: the requested 25% discount is above the 15% limit.

_oracle: What a correct run produces. graders.test.ts builds it with the real scripts and expects every code check to pass.
